sources.snippet: The tie-break adapter is a distillation: it learned the choices of a teacher 34 times its size, Qwen3.8-27B, and on 106 tie-breaks it never saw it agrees with that teacher more often than a 35-billion-parameter model does, with 11 times fewer wrong choices.
